[IERR.2.3.3] `DS_ERR_ENGINE_HALTED` is the one generic code that is not
retryable. `DS_ERR_STATE` means "not legal right now"; this means "never again
on this engine" — an `EngineError` halted its tier ([NCBK.2.9]), or a load
failed ([RDSC.9.8]), during this call or an earlier one. The caller **should** stop calling that engine, read the
halt's cause and the load-time provenance if it needs them (the calls
[NCBK.2.9] leaves valid), and free it.

The halt is a whole-engine condition whose causes span subsystems — an
artefact whose values contradict its own types, memory exhaustion with no
declared cap, a `pump_wcet_ns` overrun, a failed load — so the code names none
of them; the cause is the `EngineError`'s, or the failed load's own status.
